svg.desc: Every recorded graph edge, from Situated Activities and Stakeholders through Human Values, Value Tensions, Human Factors Concepts, Measures, Evaluation Methods and Technology Options, to Objectives, Functions, Premises and Claims.
svg.text: Tooth brushing (SA-01) is this cycle's spine. Dashed orange = strains a Value Tension; dotted purple = adverse Claim (designed to fail the design, not confirm it). Deferred UC02 material shown faded.
